name: LumiArc Modern LED Floor Lamp
description: The LumiArc Modern LED Floor Lamp features a sleek arc design with a brushed gold metal pole and a matte white drum shade. Built-in dimmable LED bulb (12W, equivalent to 80W) with 3 color temperature settings: warm white (2700K), neutral (4000K), and cool daylight (6000K). Weighted marble base for stability. Perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, and offices.
shortDescription: Modern arc LED floor lamp with dimmable 12W bulb, 3 color temperatures and marble base.
